name: @linguaflow/github-action
description: GitHub Action for LinguaFlow localization pull, validation, generation and publishing.

scripts.build: pnpm clean && esbuild src/main.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --target=node24 --legal-comments=none --minify-whitespace --outfile=dist/index.cjs && esbuild src/action-input.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --target=node24 --legal-comments=none --minify-whitespace --outfile=dist/action-input.cjs && node scripts/normalize-bundle.mjs
scripts.check: pnpm test && git diff --exit-code -- dist/index.cjs dist/action-input.cjs
